about: Probe S1 (C1): the geometric pressure index at the reception against the provider's pressure label, its extrapolated share and the incoming-ball strata. No outcome of any question: nothing after the reception frame. The rule and the index are in the docstrings of ac2fb.defence.probe_s1 and ac2fb.defence.pressure.

verdict.rule: median index strictly increasing over the five levels of overall_pressure_start, at least min_per_level receptions in each level, in at least min_matches of the calibration matches; otherwise C1 dies in the probe
